en: A snowy, narrow street lined with single‑story wooden buildings on both sides. The architecture is Northern/Eastern European, with simple facades, large windows, and signs above the shop doors. In the distance stands a taller masonry building with a clock tower or spire, partly obscured by winter haze. A single person in dark winter clothing walks down the center of the snow‑covered street; telegraph poles and wires run along the road.
